technicalContract.phases: Cœur : chronologie src/HeartAnimation.ts inchangée (1,4 s). Munition : notifyShot au vrai setOnShoot, vol/flash de 0,30 s actives ; flash seul en mouvement réduit.

assets.promptExact:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent RGBA game HUD medallion for DEAD SECTOR.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the supplied gothic Victorian FPS screenshot. Input image 2 is a palette/pixel-cluster reference, the game's existing medkit sprite. Do not edit or reproduce the screenshot.
Create ONE isolated circular health medallion matching the lower-left heart emblem in reference 1: a richly drawn anatomical human heart, vivid deep vermilion, dark crimson chambers, little warm ivory/amber highlights, legible arteries and muscular folds. An ornate antique-gold circular frame surrounds it: thin double brass ring, small Victorian acanthus leaves at lower sides, little Gothic finial at the top. Interior is near-black warm brown. Outside the medallion is genuine transparent alpha.
Style: carefully authored retro game pixel art, readable broad 2–4 px pixel clusters, angular stepped contour, rich but controlled detail. No smooth vector shapes, no photorealism, no 3D render. Gold should be tarnished ochre/brass, not bright yellow. At the intended 130px display size the red heart must read immediately and the gold ring must stay thin.
Composition: square 512x512 canvas, whole ring and ornament fit inside x=34..478 y=24..488, fully centered, no cropped tips, transparent margin. Heart occupies about 65% of inner circle. Stable static resting state, no halo outside, no sound waves, no pulse graphics.
NO letters, numbers, bars, text, extra panel, UI screenshot, buttons, hand, body, checkerboard painted background, watermark or signature. Only this one heart medallion.
transformations: Copie à l’identique du PNG généré vers le dépôt ; aucune retouche, découpe ou conversion.
evidence: Sortie du générateur inspectée ; dimensions, alpha et SHA256 mesurés.
Chargement CSS sans 404, captures de scènes préparées inspectées à 1280 × 720 et 1024 × 768 ; géométrie HUD contrôlée aussi à 1920 × 1080 et 2560 × 1080.

assets.promptExact:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: four-frame heart beat sprite atlas for a restrained pixel-art survival horror HUD.
Attached image is the accepted BASE IDENTITY, anatomy and palette. Produce a NEW 2x2 animation atlas with four equal square cells: top-left resting(0), top-right mild contraction(1), bottom-left deepest contraction(2), bottom-right release/rebound(3).
Every cell contains the SAME small anatomical heart from the reference with identical three top arteries, aortic arch, ventricular divide, orientation, colors and center anchor. Strict32x32 logical pixel grid within each cell, broad square clusters, six flat muted wine/brick-red colors and transparent background. No gradients, shine, fine veins or new details.
Animation is VERY SUBTLE: leave the top arteries completely fixed in every cell. Only the lower ventricular masses squeeze inward by about ONE native pixel, then relax. Top-left is the exact resting silhouette, top-right slight squeeze, bottom-left lower lobes one pixel narrower and one pixel higher, bottom-right near resting with a small internal rebound. No translation, no rotation, no global scale, no change in brightness, no glow.
Composition: four equal square cells in a perfect2x2 grid, no separator lines. Each heart has the same logical top/bottom anchor and same15% transparent padding. Nothing crosses cell boundaries. Entire sheet genuine transparent alpha, each heart opaque. No panel, border, frame, medallion, text, numbers, labels, shadow, painted checkerboard or watermark. Clear pixel art, NOT a high-resolution medical illustration.

The full asset is opaque where the heart is, genuine transparent alpha elsewhere. No ring, medallion, panel, text, numbers, ground, shadow, halo, checkerboard or watermark. Static resting/base pose. Export square.
